create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData object from an ASE Atoms object with neighbor graph construction using pymatgen or nvidia
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert an AtomicData object back to a list of ASE Atoms objects with energy, forces, and stress
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into a single batched AtomicData object for model inference
extract_example_from_batch: extract a single AtomicData example from a batched AtomicData object by index using get_example
update_batch_edges: update the edge connectivity of a batched AtomicData object with new edge_index, cell_offsets, and nedges tensors
